workflow_runs.name: Browser SDK R5 implementation contracts
workflow_runs.display_title: Prevent owned bookmark removal from erasing user edits

head_commit.message:
Prevent owned bookmark removal from erasing user edits

Constraint: Only the existing Bookmarks Host and tool-private mapping are changed
Rejected: Remove records with only URL identity | Cannot prove title and folder were left unchanged
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: Missing legacy snapshots must fail closed without deleting native bookmarks
Tested: Bookmarks Node regressions 12/12 and independent safety review
Not-tested: Same-candidate SDK/build chain and installed-tool Chrome lifecycle acceptance
